title: Got it hides the day-one checklist for good; Help shows the guide link line, and its button brings the checklist back
description: A real browser on the built dashboard, signed in as the owner with merged work. Pressing Got it hides the checklist, and it stays hidden after a reload. Settings → Help shows the guide link line at its top, linking to the owner's public guide in a new tab, and has one Show the first-time checklist button; pressing it opens Home with the checklist shown again, and it is still shown after a reload.

steps.name: dismiss with Got it, reopen from Help
